newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda sells $7.7 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Uganda sells $7.7 million in T-bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Uganda (BOU) said on Thursday it sold eight billion shillings ($7.7 million) of 91-day treasury bills at its auction on Wednesday.
BOU posted its annualised yield on the T-bills at 10.048 percent, an increase of 0.181 point over last week.
It said the price range stood at 97.626 to 97 compared to 97.570 to 97.485 last week. The central bank tendered for treasury bills worth $15 million to be auctioned next week.
